## Quarto

```{r}
# Load the discovery data from the same folder as this file
file.exists("/home/projects/22123/IMvigor210_plain.rds")

# Load the RDS file
data <- readRDS("/home/projects/22123/IMvigor210_plain.rds")

# Inspect the data
str(data)
```

```{r}
counts <- data$counts
tpm <- data$tpm
clinical <- data$clinical
```

```{r}
# Dimensions
dim(data$counts)
dim(data$tpm)
dim(data$clinical)

# Check gene and sample names
head(rownames(data$counts))
head(colnames(data$counts))

# Check clinical data
head(data$clinical)

# Check missing values
sum(is.na(data$counts))
sum(is.na(data$tpm))
colSums(is.na(data$clinical))
```

```{r}
# Check whether sample names match
identical(colnames(data$counts), colnames(data$tpm))
identical(colnames(data$counts), data$clinical$sample_id)
```

```{r}
#make folder to exprot data 
# Create folder if it doesn't already exist
dir.create("../data", showWarnings = FALSE)
# Save datasets
saveRDS(counts, "../data/counts.rds")
saveRDS(tpm, "../data/tpm.rds")
saveRDS(clinical, "../data/clinical.rds")
```
